findings.evidence: `rg` shows line 97 has `@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion`, while lines 120-124 give the component equation and lines 128-134 give the map-compatibility equation.

findings.issue: `quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion` is marked `@[expose]`, exposing the body of a bundled natural transformation even though its public behavior is already characterized by `quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_app` and the commutation lemma.

findings.evidence: The analogous point-map normal forms are simp lemmas in `HopfIdealPointsNaturality.lean`: `mapPoints_quotientPointsHom` at lines 38-45, `mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply` at lines 113-121, and `coe_mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply` at lines 123-130; the new lemma at lines 128-134 has no attribute.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_inclusion_apply` unless it creates a demonstrated simp loop.
findings.issue: `mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_inclusion_apply` is the characteristic normal-form lemma for the new inclusion, but it is not tagged `@[simp]`, so users must name it manually to normalize the naturality square.

summary: The order API has the right mathematical direction, but the public surface exposes an implementation body unnecessarily and leaves the main commutation lemma out of simp normal form.
